RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the August 18, 2005/Sravana 27, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy; Coal;
Communications and Information Technology; External Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Ocean Development; Overseas Indian Affairs; Personnel, Public
Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Science and Technology; Shipping, Road
Transport and Highways; Small Scale Industries; Space; Statistics and
Programme Implementation; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
Planetarium in Rampur district of
Uttar Pradesh
†*341. SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH: Will the Minister of SCIENCE
AND TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Uttar Pradesh has sent a proposal for
establishing a planetarium in Rampur
district of Uttar Pradesh; and
(b) if so, the action taken by
Government in this regard?
Expansion of UN Security Council
*342. SHRI RAJ NATH SINGH : Will
the Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the latest position in relation to the
expansion of the UN Security Council;
(b) whether Government have been
assured of full support from the P-5;
(c) whether Government have been able
to muster support in relation to this in the
UN General Assembly; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Indian astronaut in US Space
Shuttle
*343. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the USA is examining to
include an Indian astronaut in their training
programme who would board the US-
manned space vehicle, Space Shuttle;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the status
of the proposal; and
(c) the details of the Indo-US initiatives
on space programmes in the recent years?
NH Project running behind schedule
*344. SHRI VEDPRAKASH P.
GOYAL: Will the Minister of SHIPPING,
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

108
on-going national highway projects are
running behind the scheduled time;
(b) the details of such projects and the
reasons for delay, project-wise;
(c) to what extent the construction cost
of each such project has been increased due
to delay;
(d) the details thereof; and
(e) in what manner Government
propose to meet the deadlines?
Unfair labour practices by big
factories in NCR
†*345. SHRI DARA SINGH
CHAUHAN: Will the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that big factories situated in Delhi
and NCR bring hundreds of labourers from
Bihar, Eastern UP, Orissa, Uttaranchal and
Nepal and force them to work as bonded
labourers throughout the year and send
them back to their States after paying them
a meagre amount;
(b) whether it is a fact that the reputed
companies are also involved in the racket;
(c) whether Government would make
an effort to know the facts by conducting a
sincere enquiry into this matter;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Debt burden of States
*346. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Kerala
Government's debt burden has risen to
Rs. 41,709 crores as on 31st March, 2005;
(b) the action plan of the Centre to help
the State to tackle its financial problems;
and
(c) the action plan of Government to
help the Orissa State which is also under
unsustainable debt?
Showing of Indian areas in Pakistan's
map
†*347. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some parts
of Jammu and Kashmir in the map of the
country are repeatedly displayed as
Pakistan's part and this blunder is frequently
committed by Government offices;
(b) if so, the action being taken by
Government on such serious issue;
(c) whether any company or
Government office can commit such a
blunder in drawing Indian map and display
the same on the computer; and
(d) if not, the details of the action taken
in this regard?
Regularisation of casual workers
*348. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
hundreds of casual workers working for
several years under various divisions of
CGM, BSNL in the country, particularly
in North Eastern Region; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

109
(b) if so, what is Government's stand to
make these ill fated casual workers
regular?
Increase of child labour
†*349. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the number of child
labourers has increased during the last three
years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have decided
to enact new laws to check child labour;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Employment through employment
exchanges
†*350. SHRI JANAR

Employment under PMRY
†2504. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRO AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of unemployed youths
who have been provided loan under
Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana during the
last three years;
(b) whether any target has been fixed
to make loans available during this period;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
PMRY in Uttar Pradesh
†2505. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the target of beneficiaries under
Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana in Uttar
Pradesh during the last three years, year-
wise;
(b) the number of beneficiaries who have
been sanctioned loans by banks during the
said period against the target in the State;
(c) whether it is a fact that banks are
not co-operating in achieving the targets in
the State; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor and
remedial measures proposed to be taken
by Government in this regard?
Schemes for development of ARIs
2506. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether any schemes are being
implemented by Government for the
development of Agro and Rural Industries
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
achievements made as a result of
implementation of those schemes, State-
wise;

368
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether it is a fact that India still
lags behind in "Agricultural
Mechanization"; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
being taken/proposed to be taken in this
regard?
Promotion of ARIs
†2507. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the steps that have been taken by
Government to promote the rural/
agriculture based industries;
(b) the details of rural industries in the
agriculture sector;
(c) the amount allotted by Government
to these industries for exporting the
products from these industries; and
(d) the details thereof, State-wise?
Projects under REGP
2508. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of progress which are
under progress under the Rural
Employment Generation Programme
(REGP) in various States, district-wise;
(b) the amount of funds allocated and
spent during each of the last three years,
year-wise, district-wise; and
(c) the number of people benefited
through this scheme since its
inception?
Agreement between Atomic Institutes
of India and Europe
†2509. DR. CHHATTRAPAL SINGH
LODHA:
PROF. R.B.S. VARMA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Atomic
Institutes of India and Europe have signed
an agreement;
(b) if so, the details of the agreement
between the two Institutes; and
(c) the basis of this agreement?
Increase of nuclear power generation
2510. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that generation of
electricity from different nuclear power
plants during 2004-05 was about 16,500
MUs;
(b) if so, the details of installed capacity
and generation of electricity during the year
and planned for 2005-06;
(c) whether Government have any plan
to increase capacity of nuclear power
generation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor
2511. DR. K. KASTURIRANGAN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether India plans to join the
International Thermonuclear Experimental
Reactor Project; and

369
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the nature of our participation
including the financial implications?
Augmentation of harnessing Atomic
Energy
2512. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether electric power derived from
atomic power stations, besides Hydel
Power, provides cost effective and quality
source of electricity as compared to thermal
power;
(b) whether industrialized countries
viz., the USA, UK and others in EU and
some in the pacific region are harnessing
Atomic Energy to meet their power
demands  more than on thermal power;
(c) the present status of India in this
regard vis-a-vis these countries;
(d) whether Government are
contemplating augmentation of harnessing
Atomic Energy;
(e) if so, the details thereof;
(f) if not, principle constraints therefor;
